svg.title: CampusMart User Flow Schematics
svg.desc: Complete user flow from landing page through login, onboarding, home feed, product detail, cart, checkout, and dashboard for both buyer and seller

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What should be on the CampusMart landing page?')
sendPrompt('What fields are on the sign up page?')
sendPrompt('What does the login page look like?')
sendPrompt('What onboarding steps should new students complete?')
sendPrompt('What does the CampusMart home feed show?')
sendPrompt('How does the category browse page work?')
sendPrompt('What does the search results page show?')
sendPrompt('What does the seller profile page show to buyers?')
sendPrompt('What elements are on the product detail page?')
g.text: Images · Price · Seller · Reviews · Add to Cart / Book

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the shopping cart page include?')
sendPrompt('How does buyer-seller chat work in the app?')
sendPrompt('What does the checkout flow look like step by step?')
sendPrompt('How does Paystack mobile money payment work for students?')
sendPrompt('What is shown on the order confirmation page?')
sendPrompt('What does the seller dashboard show?')
sendPrompt('What does the add listing form include?')
sendPrompt('How does a seller manage incoming orders?')

svg.text: Click any screen to ask Claude about it
